historyTimeline.h2: Jaguar XE S - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the Jaguar XE S launched, it served as the high-performance flagship of the compact executive XE range, delivering 380hp from a proven supercharged V6. Throughout its production run, it retained this singular, potent engine architecture, prioritising linear power delivery and distinctive sound over the four-cylinder Ingenium units found in lower trims.

milestones.description: AJ126, 3.0L V6 Supercharged Petrol, 380hp (Launch of the XE S, featuring the carry-over AJ-V6 supercharged engine from the XF/XJ).
Final model year for the dedicated XE S V6 variant, as Jaguar shifted the performance focus of the facelifted XE range toward the high-output 2.0L Ingenium P300 MHEV.

commonProblems.h2: Jaguar XE S Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Jaguar XE S reliability profile is defined by the AJ126 3.0L supercharged V6. While generally more robust than the four-cylinder Ingenium diesels, it has specific, well-documented vulnerabilities, particularly concerning the cooling system and supercharger drivetrain. Rebuilt engines supplied through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, backed by a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Supercharger Coupler Wear - Why the Jaguar XE S AJ126 Develops a Rattle
problems.rootCause: The rubber isolator (coupler) between the supercharger snout and the drive pulley degrades over time due to heat and torque loads, causing a distinct rattling or whining noise on acceleration.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Removing the supercharger snout and replacing the worn rubber isolator with an updated, more durable part.
repairOptions.longevity: Highly effective if caught early before secondary damage occurs to the supercharger rotors.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a fully rebuilt AJ126 with upgraded cooling and timing components, plus 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the rattling has been ignored, leading to internal supercharger or timing chain damage.

problems.recommendation: If your Jaguar XE S is exhibiting early signs of a supercharger rattle or minor coolant seepage, addressing it immediately with a specialist repair is the most economical path. However, if the vehicle has suffered overheating or severe internal knocking, a full rebuilt AJ126 engine is the only reliable long-term solution to restore the car's performance safely.

problems.h4: Cooling System Leaks - Water Pump and Crossover Pipe Failures in the Jaguar XE S
problems.rootCause: Plastic coolant crossover pipes and water pump housings become brittle under repeated thermal cycling, leading to external coolant leaks that can rapidly cause the engine to overheat.

repairOptions.tier: Intermediate - Water Pump & Crossover Pipe Replacement
repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Draining the cooling system, replacing the failed plastic pipes and water pump with updated components, and refilling with correct Jaguar-spec coolant.
repairOptions.longevity: The standard and most cost-effective repair if the engine has not overheated.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a rebuilt AJ126, necessary if coolant loss led to overheating, warped cylinder heads, or seized components.
repairOptions.longevity: Mandatory if the temperature gauge spiked and the engine was driven while overheating.

items.question: What are the signs of supercharger failure in a Jaguar XE S?
items.answer: The most common early warning sign is a distinct rattling or whining noise from the front of the engine during acceleration, caused by a worn supercharger coupler.
keyPoints: A metallic rattle on startup may also indicate timing chain tensioner wear.
Loss of boost pressure or hesitation under hard acceleration.
Check engine lights related to camshaft position or fuel trim.
items.cta: -> Get quotes for AJ126 Jaguar XE S engine replacement

items.question: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Jaguar XE S?
items.answer: Yes, replacing the engine is often financially sensible, as the XE S retains strong residual values (£8,000-£18,000) compared to the cost of a rebuilt unit.
keyPoints: A rebuilt AJ126 with upgraded components restores the car's 380hp performance reliably.
It is significantly cheaper than purchasing a comparable used XE S with unknown history.
The 12-month unlimited mileage warranty provides peace of mind that a used engine swap cannot match.
items.cta: -> Assess your Jaguar XE S repair vs replace options

items.question: How long does a Jaguar XE S engine replacement take?
items.answer: A professional Jaguar XE S engine swap typically takes 2 to 3 days at a specialist workshop.
keyPoints: The AJ126 V6 requires careful extraction and installation due to the supercharger and tight engine bay packaging.
Post-installation, the vehicle requires Topix diagnostic programming to pair the new ECU and clear adaptation values.
Nationwide supply and fit services can often schedule this within a week of engine dispatch.
items.cta: -> Book a Jaguar XE S supply and fit service

items.question: What is the difference between a used and a reconditioned Jaguar XE S engine?
items.answer: A used Jaguar XE S engine is a second-hand unit pulled from another vehicle, while a reconditioned engine has been professionally stripped, inspected, and rebuilt with new wear items.
keyPoints: Reconditioned AJ126 engines include updated water pumps, crossover pipes, and supercharger couplers to prevent repeat failures.
Used engines are cheaper upfront (£2,500-£4,500) but carry the same mileage and wear risks as your original unit.
Reconditioned units come with a minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty, making them the superior long-term investment.
